text:
anna: Quick dark-mode accessibility pass on the telemetry dashboard. Found three things: focus ring gets clipped under the sticky header, status pills lose contrast on dark bg, and screen reader reads the sticky header twice when it pins.

chris: good catch. which browsers? repro steps?

anna: mac Safari & Chrome, repro: 1) enable dark mode, 2) open Telemetry > Overview, 3) tab to the search input then Shift+Tab to see focus ring clipped under header; 4) notice status pills in the table (green/amber) are borderline contrast at 13px; 5) enable VoiceOver and scroll until header pins - VO reads header brand then brand again.

lucy: i can reproduce the clipping. looks like header has a higher z-index but a negative margin on the content wrapper makes the ring render behind. also the duplicated announce sounds like we have a duplicated heading element for the pinned and unpinned header both present in DOM with aria-live updating.

chris: quick fixes: (1) ensure focus styles use outline-offset or box-shadow so they aren't clipped by overflow:hidden; (2) switch status pills to --status-success-strong and --status-warning-strong tokens in dark mode; (3) for the header pin, keep only one accessible heading: when we render a pinned clone, set aria-hidden="true" on the original or vice versa.

ops-bot: Automated check (axe): color-contrast x2, focus-order x1, duplicate-content-announcement x1.

anna: sample CSS for focus: .input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--a11y-focus); outline: none; } also add overflow: visible on the container that houses focused items.

chris: will PR small patch: focus clipping fix + token swap + aria-hidden on duplicate header. will include unit test for header announce and a screenshot pair for contrast.

lucy: i'll run VoiceOver/NVDA check on the preview and mark QA blocked until fixes land.

anna: thanks — keeping this in the next patch. small fixes but noticeable in dark mode. :eyes:
